meta.title: Nerve · The two-pass approval gate
meta.subtitle: SessionApprovalSystem gate before NetworkId, then identity once it exists — and why require-connection-approval changes what a refusal can still do

views.label: Flag + handshake
views.note: ConfigVar is copied onto NetworkStreamDriver before Listen/Connect; flag on parks in State.Approval with no NetworkId.

views.label: Pass 1 · gate
views.note: SessionApprovalSystem stamps ConnectionApproved or NetworkStreamRequestDisconnect before NetCode assigns NetworkId (when the flag is on).

views.label: Pass 2 · identity → PCS
views.note: AccountIdentity local-{networkId} lands only after NetworkId; PlayerConnectionSystem matches the full quartet.

messages.label: RequireConnectionApproval ← ConfigVar
messages.note: network.require-connection-approval is copied onto the driver before Listen/Connect; flip after bind logs an error and has no effect.

messages.label: flag OFF → ApproveConnection + NetworkId
messages.note: With the flag off NetCode auto-approves at handshake end. A later refuse is only a kick a few frames after a real NetworkId already exists.

messages.label: flag ON → State.Approval · no NetworkId
messages.note: ServerRequestApprovalAfterHandshake is sent; only IApprovalRpcCommand traffic is allowed until ConnectionApproved appears. Non-approval RPCs disconnect as InvalidRpc.

messages.label: +ConnectionApproved
messages.note: Pass 1 acts only when state is Approval or NetworkId is already present — the dual shape that works with the ConfigVar on or off. Counts existing ConnectionApproved against session.max-players.

messages.label: +NetworkStreamRequestDisconnect ApprovalFailure
messages.note: Server full. With the flag ON the refused client never receives a NetworkId and never gets a snapshot. With the flag OFF the peer already had a full connection for a few frames.

messages.label: ApproveConnection → NetworkId
messages.note: NetworkStreamReceiveSystem calls ApproveConnection the moment ConnectionApproved appears while requireConnectionApproval is set and state is Approval. Client auto-tags ConnectionApproved from ServerApprovedConnection; the server marker is game-authored only.

messages.label: +AccountIdentity local-{networkId}
messages.note: Pass 2 runs only after NetworkId exists. The string is fake and recycle-unsafe; PlayerConnectionSystem reconnect keys on it.

messages.label: quartet: Approved · Identity · NetworkId · CommandTarget
messages.note: PlayerConnectionSystem spawns only when all four are on the server connection. Missing ConnectionApproved or AccountIdentity is a silent no-op — NetworkId alone is not enough.

cards.title: Two passes, one reason
items: Pass 1 decides yes/no before NetCode hands out NetworkId (when approval is required)
Pass 2 names the account only after NetworkId exists
PlayerConnectionSystem needs both stamps plus NetworkId and CommandTarget

cards.title: ConfigVar changes refusal
items: ON: State.Approval holds the door — refused clients get no NetworkId and no snapshots
OFF: NetCode auto-approves; a project refuse is a post-hoc kick after a real connection
Public bind wants the flag true so a refusal is not a brief full peer

cards.title: Server tags are not free
items: ConnectionApproved on the client does not appear on the server
AccountIdentity is Nerve-only — NetCode never stamps it
local-{networkId} collides after NetworkId recycle without destroy-on-leave
